entry_points.text: Cmdline fetch pins space, snapshots bounds under guard, copies arguments with bounded remote access, normalizes separators. Deferred handlers release nodes, reclaim areas and drain purge. Proc exposes diagnostics. Pressure cleanup delegates to version handler.

exports.text: Admission accounts pages then applies overcommit policy: always succeeds, guess checks RAM plus swap only, strict derives ceiling minus privileged reserve and per-space allowance. Failure warns, reverses accounting, reports shortage.

Diagnosis tries slab then vmalloc checks before classifying pointers as vmalloc, direct valid, null, zero sentinel, or non-paged. Vmalloc path aligns down, resolves node, try-acquires busy guard, reports pages, base and site only with metadata.

Area reservation requests full-range extents with page alignment and recorded caller. Early boot keeps sorted init list, rejects overlaps, scans for first fitting gap. Group ops reserve several ranges sharing one base, releasing each plus array on free.

Mappers reserve areas then install pages or frames with kernel or IO protections, rejecting excessive counts, reset permissions and guard suppression. RAM path splits small block versus dedicated areas with tag scrub and poison. Remap exports kernel pages to user with overflow and alignment checks.

Node-aware wrappers provide plain, zeroing, huge-capable, user-mapped with shared alignment, node-pinned, and low 32-bit variants, delegating to ranged helpers with kernel protections and recorded caller.

Notifier add and remove operate on shared chain. Range read copies mapped bytes while zero-filling gaps and tolerating outside ranges. Pressure notification, grading and init turn scan versus reclaim observations into low, medium or critical signals.

hazards.text: Shrink, relocation and stack creation fail cleanly on shortage with accounting reversal and no other effects. Failing points are iterator preallocation, expansion, table move and area allocation. Killable lock acquisition can abort stack creation with interruption.

Callers face hard checks for empty, oversize, unaligned, out-of-range or unknown areas, guard suppression and permission misuse, excessive counts, degraded growth, mismatched sizes, and mapping valid frames as special. Failures warn and unwind without partial install.

Overflow clamps to address end; shifts and additions check overflow; misaligned inputs reject. Concurrent uninitialized marks use barriers. Carve inconsistencies warn and merge back. Contention, absent backing, malformed walks and bad sparse requests fail safe.

invariants.text: Translation walks levels in order, returns absent on empty, warns on malformed, resolves huge leaves with offset, requires present final entry. Unmapping flushes cache, removes without flush, then flushes translations over same span.

Descriptors link flags, caller, address from area start, sizes from extent, and back-pointer. Block addresses stay in one block. Per-CPU queues serve local paths. Order delegates to shared helper. Diagnostic reads substitute zeroes for holes under block guard, accepting teardown races.

Free space complements busy entries. Nodes prepare busy, lazy, pools and locks with single default and bounded scaling. Boot imports busy, builds free space, marks ready, registers shrinker. Reporting sums cached extents; scanning decays each node once under purge mutex. Diagnostics list busy, owned and lazy extents with NUMA breakdown.

Grade scales unreclaimed fraction to percent with full reclaim yielding zero, mapping below medium to low, below critical to medium, else critical. Window is sixteen times swap-cluster maximum with medium sixty and critical ninety-five.

locks.text: Offline control uses one read-write semaphore with freeze and thaw as read hold and release, begin and end as write hold and release. Read side allows concurrent freezes while write side excludes them.

Global mutex guards address-space locking and global spin guard protects free space across carve and rollback. Purge mutex serializes lazy reclamation; periodic work holds it across maximal purge declining forced flush.

state_machines.text: Shrink requires new end within old, preallocates, enters write mode, adjusts huge state, clears tail, updates, completes and validates. Relocation validates ordering, expands spans, moves tables, frees vacated range, then shrinks. Stack allocates, locks killably, sets sharing, marks stack, places one page at top, inserts, publishes, unwinds on failure.

Sparse mapping validates sleep context, rejects reset permission, no-guard and non-sparse areas, rejects spans larger than RAM or outside area, then maps with kernel protection or unmaps with cache and translation flushing. Unmap validation failure returns silently.

Successor search strips tagging, walks each busy tree for first area ending beyond address preferring containment, tracks lowest start across nodes, then relooks under owning node lock. If candidate vanished the scan repeats; otherwise owning node stays locked on return.

Block creation reserves aligned area, inits guard and counters, indexes and publishes; failures unwind. Allocation rejects bad sizes, scans local list, claims suffix, unlinks when exhausted, else creates block. Release clears bitmap, tears down range, expands dirty interval, frees fully dirty blocks. Realloc frees on zero, allocates on null, validates alignment and node, shrinks in place or copies anew.

structs.text: Mapping state holds space, iterator, range, offsets, length, flags, file, protections, hooks, charged amount, neighbours, unmap helper and hints. Prepare, batch, unmap, merge and descriptor records carry areas, files, spaces, policies, fault context, names, outcomes and accounting.

Vmap uses tree, list and guard triples for busy and lazy, pools, nodes with locks, hints, purge work and counts. Queues hold free lists plus stores. Blocks carry guard, area link, counters, bitmap, interval, links, callback and owner. Deferred free pairs list with work per CPU; fit enumerates placement.

Pages derive from extent over page size. Small cap is word bits. Bitmaps bound between twice cap and 1024, clamped by pages, CPUs and 16. Block size is bits times page size. Purge threshold is quarter bitmap. RAM is 1, block 2, mask 3. Largest pooled is 256 pages. KASAN batch 32. Extents 128M or 128G.

Mask allows sleepable plus atomic, no-wait, no-fail, zeroing, no-retry, may-fail, filesystem-less, IO-less, accounted, user, no-lockdep and skip-KASAN, with low DMA variants. Huge controls have mutable early-boot or fixed builds. Free root empty, lazy zero.
